To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of к-carragenean and NaCl to frozen surimi has a positive effect on its thermal properties.

1) the increase of NaCl content in the frozen surimi results in the increase of the bound water and decrease in the initial freezing point, which leads to the decrease of thermal properties of the frozen surimi; 2) addition of к-carragenean in the frozen surimis results in the decrease of the bound water content, which leads to increase of the initial freezing point and thermal properties of the surimi.

the addition of carrageenan and NaCI in surimi can improve its thermal properties and, thus, the quality of frozen products.
, in addition to the known effects of NaCl on the thermal properties of frozen fish surimi, к-carrageanan can have similar effects, but with different mechanisms.
